summary: Black Titan Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Brynner Chiam as Interim Co-CEO, effective July 10, 2026. He will serve alongside Shang Ju Lin while continuing as CFO and director. The appointment is a transitional move, not a forced departure. No material terms, advisor, or compensation changes were disclosed. The filing is routine; no structural or financial event is present. Watch for further management stability signals.
